name: Shoutengai
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood shopping street (Fureai Shoutengai): a notice about raffle hours changing, a first day working part-time at a flower shop, a store-hours guide, a notice that the point card now works via smartphone, an autumn festival guide, a lesson learned about customer-focused service, teaching a new part-time clerk the register, an essay on why vacant shops increased, a point-card how-to guide, a column on how online ordering changed the daily flow, a promotion association's new bylaws, a reflection on the meaning of time accumulated in a shopping street, and a one-year cooperation report with a local revitalization council. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
